Browser workflows on the real stack (regression)

scenario_results.observed: Customer web basket (CW05): component tests drive real meal pages and the cart; 2 × 120.25 + 95.50 shows an estimated subtotal of 336.00 EGP; raising A2 gives 431.50, lowering A1 gives 311.25, removing A1 gives 191.00, removing the last line shows the empty state and clears storage; quantity stays within 1 and min(20, portions when added) (3 portions: 360.75); all four replacement paths keep or replace the exact saved kitchen, slot and lines with estimates 240.50 / 80.25 / 240.50 / 95.50; the kitchen name is shown; the estimate is labelled separately from the server quote, an edit removes a quote already shown and the next quote request carries the new quantity; a pending placement disables editing. The keyboard browser journey (BROWSER-E2E, real stack) raises and lowers a basket quantity and sees the estimate. Tests were run red first (RED-web-FG-001.log). Fixes QA finding FG-001; pending independent retest.

Customer web component tests with a bilingual fake API that answers in the request's Accept-Language: switching Arabic → English → Arabic on browse, meal detail and kitchen page sends each request in the chosen language and shows that language's title, description, portion text and kitchen name; an English answer held back until after the switch back to Arabic is never shown. Red against the unchanged code (RED-web-MBQA-001-002.log). Fixes QA finding MBQA-001; pending independent retest. Native client is created per language (not affected).

Customer web and native component tests with a meal whose first slot has 0 portions and second 3: selecting the exhausted slot leaves Add disabled, shows that the time is sold out, and writes nothing to the basket; the slot with stock caps the quantity at 3 and adds exactly that meal × 3 in that slot; switching back to the exhausted slot cannot rewrite the basket; an entirely sold-out meal stays unpurchasable. Red against the unchanged code on web and native (RED-web-MBQA-001-002.log, RED-native-MBQA-002.log). Server stock enforcement unchanged (BACKEND-VERIFY). Fixes QA finding MBQA-002; pending independent retest.

findings: Repairs for independent Codex QA findings MBQA-002, MBQA-001 and FG-001 (report at a7ed1f3, tested eb1a671); status FIXED_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_RETEST, not closed by independent QA.
Every regression test was run against the unchanged product code first and failed for the reported reason; logs are kept in this run directory.
A further defect found by the new tests (meal page kept the previous meal's quantity on direct meal-to-meal navigation) was fixed by keying the page by meal id.
The basket's unit price and portion limit are display-only snapshots for the estimate; quotes send meal ids and quantities only, and the server remains authoritative for price and stock.

Not resolved here: RQ-001/RQ-002/RQ-003 (proposals in docs/quality/07-codex-qa-repair.md), Q1 per-line limit, operations-web language follow-up, native emulator/simulator verification of basket editing (MB-032).
